scope: State-free producer-local ReadIssueDescriptor to SourceCandidate refinement. It is not instantiated in the production top and does not allocate context, enter R2, launch R1, process a response, mutate payload, make a source deliverable, emit a scoreboard event, or make physical/timing/PPA/numeric/model claims.

module.name: route_a_read_issue_candidate_adapter
module.input_owner: future named R3 or R5 source fact owner
module.output_owner: future named producer lane; R2 remains sole arbiter

fail_closed_conditions: candidate_class is not a frozen read class
invariants: The adapter never selects between producers or changes arrival_ordinal/candidate_id/eligibility_snapshot.
The adapter never allocates, binds, releases, or reconstructs a delivery context reference.
A legal candidate remains stable while valid and ready is low.
No R2 rotation, credit, FIFO, or R1 acceptance is caused by isolated adapter operation.
No source deliverability or authority transition follows from candidate construction.
